# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.2 Worker 1: Celestial subjects, charter goals, zone names and track texts (oe_cel_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v112_celestial_subjects.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Subject scope (on_enable). Needs scope:oe_cel_lord (the overlord). Writes var:oe_cel_track_tag 1-5 and the flavour modifier.
oe_cel_apply_track_subject_flavor = {
	oe_cel_clear_track_subject_flavor = yes
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel_lord }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_yuan_track = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_tag value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_fanwang_yuan_mod mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_han_ming_track = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_tag value = 2 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_fanwang_ming_mod mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_manchu_qing_track = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_tag value = 3 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_fanwang_qing_mod mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_sinosphere_alt_track = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_tag value = 4 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_fanwang_alt_mod mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_foreign_conqueror_track = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_tag value = 5 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_fanwang_foreign_mod mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_yuan_track = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_tag value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_xuanweisi_yuan_mod mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_han_ming_track = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_tag value = 2 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_xuanweisi_ming_mod mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_manchu_qing_track = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_tag value = 3 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_xuanweisi_qing_mod mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_sinosphere_alt_track = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_tag value = 4 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_xuanweisi_alt_mod mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_foreign_conqueror_track = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_tag value = 5 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_xuanweisi_foreign_mod mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_yuan_track = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_tag value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_grand_duhu_yuan_mod mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_han_ming_track = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_tag value = 2 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_grand_duhu_ming_mod mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				scope:oe_cel_lord = { oe_cel_is_manchu_qing_track = yes }

			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_grand_duhu_foreign_mod mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# Subject scope (on_disable). Removes every track flavour modifier.
oe_cel_clear_track_subject_flavor = {
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_fanwang_yuan_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_fanwang_ming_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_fanwang_qing_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_fanwang_alt_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_fanwang_foreign_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_xuanweisi_yuan_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_xuanweisi_ming_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_xuanweisi_qing_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_xuanweisi_alt_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_xuanweisi_foreign_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_grand_duhu_yuan_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_grand_duhu_ming_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_grand_duhu_qing_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_grand_duhu_alt_mod
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cel_grand_duhu_foreign_mod
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_track_tag }
		remove_variable = oe_cel_track_tag
	}
}

# Country scope (the throne). Revocation heat +1, capped at 5 (read by W3 revoke and W4 crisis).
oe_cel_bump_revocation_tension = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_revocation_heat } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_revocation_heat value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_cel_revocation_heat < 5 }
		change_variable = { name = oe_cel_revocation_heat add = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope (the throne). Revocation heat -N (N = amount), floor 0.
oe_cel_cool_revocation_tension = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_revocation_heat }
		change_variable = { name = oe_cel_revocation_heat subtract = $amount$ }
		if = {
			limit = { var:oe_cel_revocation_heat < 0 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_revocation_heat value = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (the throne). Counts the three subject types and the zones covered by grand protectorates.
# Only walks the throne's own subjects (no map scan).
oe_cel_sync_duhu_count = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_cel_fanwang_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_cel_xuanweisi_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_cel_duhu_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_cel_global_continents value = 0 }
	every_subject = {
		limit = { is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang }
		prev = { change_variable = { name = oe_cel_fanwang_count add = 1 } }
	}
	every_subject = {
		limit = { is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi }
		prev = { change_variable = { name = oe_cel_xuanweisi_count add = 1 } }
	}
	every_subject = {
		limit = { is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu }
		prev = { change_variable = { name = oe_cel_duhu_count add = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_subject = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				capital ?= { oe_cel_loc_in_zone_anxi = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_zone_anxi value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = oe_cel_global_continents add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_zone_anxi }
		remove_variable = oe_cel_zone_anxi
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_subject = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				capital ?= { oe_cel_loc_in_zone_beiting = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_zone_beiting value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = oe_cel_global_continents add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_zone_beiting }
		remove_variable = oe_cel_zone_beiting
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_subject = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				capital ?= { oe_cel_loc_in_zone_andong = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_zone_andong value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = oe_cel_global_continents add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_zone_andong }
		remove_variable = oe_cel_zone_andong
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_subject = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				capital ?= { oe_cel_loc_in_zone_annan = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_zone_annan value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = oe_cel_global_continents add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_zone_annan }
		remove_variable = oe_cel_zone_annan
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_subject = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				capital ?= { oe_cel_loc_in_zone_jiugang = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_zone_jiugang value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = oe_cel_global_continents add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_zone_jiugang }
		remove_variable = oe_cel_zone_jiugang
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_subject = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				capital ?= { oe_cel_loc_in_zone_tianzhu = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_zone_tianzhu value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = oe_cel_global_continents add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_zone_tianzhu }
		remove_variable = oe_cel_zone_tianzhu
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_subject = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				capital ?= { oe_cel_loc_in_zone_dashi = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_zone_dashi value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = oe_cel_global_continents add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_zone_dashi }
		remove_variable = oe_cel_zone_dashi
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_subject = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				capital ?= { oe_cel_loc_in_zone_kunlun = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_zone_kunlun value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = oe_cel_global_continents add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_zone_kunlun }
		remove_variable = oe_cel_zone_kunlun
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_subject = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				capital ?= { oe_cel_loc_in_zone_taixi = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_zone_taixi value = 1 }

# Any scope. Gives each of the four v11.2 Middle Kingdom laws its default policy if it has none (new and loaded games).
oe_cel_init_default_io_policies = {
	international_organization:middle_kingdom ?= {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_enf_touxia_feudal
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_enf_overseas_princes
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_enf_tui_en_centralize
				}
			}
			add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_cel_pol_enf_touxia_feudal
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_jimi_classic_tusi
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_jimi_sihai_duhu
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_jimi_lifan_huayi
				}
			}
			add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_cel_pol_jimi_classic_tusi
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_gtgl_gradual_charter
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_gtgl_provincial_wave
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_gtgl_iron_commandery
				}
			}
			add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_cel_pol_gtgl_gradual_charter
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_ocean_tribute_gate
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_ocean_treasure_hegemony
					international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_ocean_continental_pivot
				}
			}
			add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_cel_pol_ocean_tribute_gate
		}
	}
}

# Dev page 83: force track 1 (yuan).
oe_cel_dev_force_track_yuan = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_cel_track_override value = 1 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.90
}

# Dev page 83: clear the track override.
oe_cel_dev_clear_track = {
	remove_global_variable = oe_cel_track_override
}

# Dev page 83 (country scope, the throne): turn the first three eligible subjects into the three celestial types.
oe_cel_dev_make_subjects = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes }
		random_subject = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { oe_cel_is_any_celestial_subject = yes }
				NOT = { oe_cel_is_protected_yuan_province = yes }
				NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia }
			}
			change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_fanwang
		}
		random_subject = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { oe_cel_is_any_celestial_subject = yes }
				NOT = { oe_cel_is_protected_yuan_province = yes }
				NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia }
			}
			change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_xuanweisi
		}
		random_subject = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { oe_cel_is_any_celestial_subject = yes }
				NOT = { oe_cel_is_protected_yuan_province = yes }
				NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia }
			}
			change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
		}
		oe_cel_sync_duhu_count = yes
	}
}

# Dev page 83: readout.
oe_cel_dev_readout = {
	oe_cel_sync_duhu_count = yes
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.90
}
